# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: DEAF

You see the bomb: every colour on it, every marking printed on it, every reading it
gives. You hear nothing. You hold no manual, and you cannot touch the bomb.

## Your channels

When you speak, Mute and Blind receive it.
When you gesture, Mute receives it.
You never receive speech.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- The routes, by name. Speech reaches Mute and Blind, and never Deaf. Gestures
  reach Deaf and Mute, and never Blind. Deaf can speak and gesture, Mute can
  only gesture, Blind can only speak. Check every message against this list
  before you send it.

- Deaf invents the gesture code out loud before anything else moves, and
  everyone else's opening move is waiting for it. The manual's verdict reaches
  Blind only as Deaf's spoken order.

- Whatever the code becomes, it starts by being able to say YES, NO, HOLD and
  DONE. Grow it only when a message will not fit.

TURN 1
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[red] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I am establishing a fixed gesture code before any operation: 👍 = YES, 👎 = NO, ✋ = HOLD, and 👌 = DONE. I will also tell both teammates to wait for this code; the mute monkey can see the gestures, while the blind monkey receives the spoken names.

```text
speak(text="Gesture code: thumbs up means YES, thumbs down means NO, raised palm means HOLD, and OK hand means DONE. Mute, read the manual after this. Blind, HOLD.")
gesture(symbols=["👍"])
gesture(symbols=["👎"])
gesture(symbols=["✋"])
gesture(symbols=["👌"])
```

TURN 2
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[red] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👍]

Mute’s 👍 confirms that the gesture code was received. No bomb instruction has arrived yet, so the blind monkey must not manipulate anything. I am directing Mute to consult the manual and report its verdict using the established gestures; I tell Blind to hold.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="Read the manual now. Signal its verdict with the gesture code; use HOLD if more information is needed, and DONE when the manual gives a completion instruction.")
speak(to="blind", text="HOLD. Do not manipulate anything yet.")
```

TURN 3
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[red] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [✋]

Mute has signaled HOLD. I am relaying that verdict to Blind as the required spoken order; no wire should be touched or changed.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="HOLD.")
```

TURN 4
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[red] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

Mute’s HOLD means the manual has not authorized an operation yet. I am expanding the gesture code to transmit the bomb’s visible state to Mute: 🤟 means red, 🖖 blue, 🤞 green, and 🤏 zero. The sequence will be display, light, then wires 1–3. Blind must continue holding.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="Expanded code: 🤟 means RED, 🖖 means BLUE, 🤞 means GREEN, and 🤏 means ZERO. Gesture sequence order is DISPLAY, LIGHT, WIRE 1, WIRE 2, WIRE 3.")
gesture(to="mute", symbols=["🤏","🤟","🖖","🤟","🤞"])
speak(to="blind", text="HOLD. The visible state is being relayed to Mute for manual interpretation.")
```

TURN 5
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[red] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [🤟 👌]

Mute reported 🤟 👌, which under our code means RED, DONE. I am relaying that manual verdict to Blind exactly; I will not invent an operation that was not specified.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Manual verdict reported: RED. DONE.")
```

TURN 6
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[red] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The previous report from Mute was only “RED, DONE,” which does not identify a safe physical action. The bomb remains unchanged. I am giving Blind the complete visible state and instructing Mute to provide the manual’s actual operation, not merely a color/status acknowledgment.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Current visible state: display 0, light RED, wire 1 BLUE, wire 2 RED, wire 3 GREEN. HOLD; do not touch anything until the manual gives an explicit operation.")
speak(to="mute", text="Your last signal meant RED, DONE, but it did not state the operation. Read the manual for this exact state and signal the required action; use HOLD if there is no authorized action yet.")
```

TURN 7
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[red] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [✋]

Mute again signals HOLD, so there is still no safe action to relay. The existing code cannot express a specific operation, so I am adding only the needed action vocabulary: ✊ means CUT, and ☝, ✌, 🤟 mean wire 1, 2, and 3 respectively. Mute should use an action sequence followed by 👌 if the manual authorizes it; Blind must continue holding.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="Additions: fist means CUT; index-up means wire 1; V-sign means wire 2; horns means wire 3. To report an authorized operation, gesture CUT, then its wire number, then DONE. If none is authorized, gesture HOLD.")
speak(to="blind", text="HOLD. Mute has not yet reported an authorized operation.")
```

TURN 8
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[red] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [✊ ✌ 👌]

Mute has reported the authorized sequence CUT, wire 2, DONE. I am relaying that exact operation to Blind, who is the only one able to manipulate the bomb.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="CUT wire 2, then DONE.")
```

TURN 9
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [yellow]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[CUT] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed

The correct wire was cut, and the bomb has changed: the display remains 0, the light is now YELLOW, wire 2 is CUT, while wires 1 and 3 remain BLUE and GREEN. I am sending the new state to Mute for the manual’s next instruction and ordering Blind to hold.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="New state: display 0, light YELLOW, wire 1 BLUE, wire 2 CUT, wire 3 GREEN. Read the manual for the next required operation and report it with the established code.")
speak(to="blind", text="HOLD. The bomb changed after the correct cut; await the next manual instruction.")
```

TURN 10
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [yellow]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[CUT] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [✊ ☝ 👌]

Mute reports CUT, wire 1, DONE. I am relaying that exact authorized operation to Blind. Afterward, Blind should wait for the bomb’s resulting state.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="CUT wire 1, then DONE.")
```

TURN 11
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [blue]
WIRES 1:[CUT] 2:[CUT] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed

Wire 1 was cut correctly, and the bomb changed again: display 0, light BLUE, wires 1 and 2 CUT, and wire 3 GREEN. I am sending this current state to Mute for the manual’s next instruction and telling Blind to hold.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="New state: display 0, light BLUE, wire 1 CUT, wire 2 CUT, wire 3 GREEN. Read the manual for the next required operation and report it with the established code.")
speak(to="blind", text="HOLD. Await the next manual instruction.")
```

TURN 12
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [blue]
WIRES 1:[CUT] 2:[CUT] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [✊ 🤟 👌]

Mute reports CUT, wire 3, DONE. I am relaying that authorized operation to Blind.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="CUT wire 3, then DONE.")
```
